# lakreet-swarm init

Generate a starter CSV from a template.

## Synopsis

```bash
lakreet-swarm init --template T.ectemplate --data D.csv [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--template` | string |  | FILE     EffectCraft template (.ectemplate) |
| `--data` | string |  | FILE         Data file (.csv/.tsv/.json/.jsonl) |
| `--out` | string | out | DIR           Output folder (default: out) |
| `--cli` | string |  | PATH          Path to effectcraft-cli |
| `--config` | string | lakreet.config.json | FILE       Config file (default: lakreet.config.json) |
| `--name` | string | {index}-{first} | PATTERN      Output name pattern (default: {index}-{first}) |
| `--only` | string |  | LIST         Select rows, e.g. 1,3,5-8 |
| `--limit` | string |  | N           Process only the first N rows |
| `--skip-existing` | string |  | Skip rows whose output already exists |
| `--retries` | string |  | N         Extra attempts for a failed render |
| `--fail-fast` | string |  | Stop at the first failure |
| `--timeout` | string |  | SEC       Per-render timeout |
| `--format` | string |  | F          h264|webm|png|jpeg|gif|... |
| `--resolution` | string |  | R      full|half|third|quarter |
| `--quality` | string |  | Q         best|draft |
| `--fps` | string |  | N             Frame rate |
| `--bitrate` | string |  | KBPS      Video bitrate |
| `--audio` | string |  | MODE        auto|on|off |
| `--keep-values` | string |  | Keep per-row values JSON files |
| `--empty-as-default` | string |  | Treat empty text cells as template default |
| `--dry-run` | string |  | Validate without rendering |
| `--json` | string |  | Machine-readable NDJSON output |
| `--quiet` | string |  |  |
| `--no-color` | string |  | Disable colour |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 0 | OK |
| 1 | Render failed |
| 2 | Usage error |
| 3 | Invalid data |
| 4 | effectcraft-cli not found |
| 5 | Template unreadable |
| 130 | Interrupted (Ctrl+C) |

## Examples

```bash
# lakreet-swarm init --template template.ectemplate --out data.csv
```
